anchor.statement: Lemma 9.2. Let w be a wave in W α , and let v be a mean field with tangential components in M µ and radial component in M µ +1 . The nonzero harmonics of (w · ∇ ∗ )v + (v · ∇ ∗ )w belong to W α + µ −1/2 .

correspondence.note: Mean–wave cross-advection in W^{α+µ−1/2}, same-label transport in W^{α+α'−κ} (for each ordered transport; the symmetric sum is their sum) and zero products for distinct labels are stated. The clause that the zero harmonic of a same-label product lies in M^{α+α'−κs} has no counterpart.

exact.text:
∀ {D : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup D] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ D] {s : NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.StripData D}
  {P : ℕ → D → ℝ} {α β κ : ℝ} (G : NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.Geometry s κ),
  0 ≤ κ →
    ∀ {Φ : ℕ → D → ℝ} {ν ξ : ℕ → ℝ} {a b B : NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.Family D},
      NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.WaveVector s P α a →
        NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.WaveVector s P β b →
          (∀ (n : ℕ), ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (Φ n) s.domain) →
            (∀ (n : ℕ), ν n ≠ 0) →
              (NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.BandBound s 0 fun (n : ℕ) => ξ n / ν n) →
                NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.AngularIndependent G a →
                  NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.AngularIndependent G b →
                    (∀ (n : ℕ),
                        NavierStokes.CurlClassBounds.CylindricalGeometry s.domain (G.radius n) (G.radial n)
                          (G.angular n) (G.axial n)) →
                      (∀ (n : ℕ), ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (B n) s.domain) →
                        (∀ (n : ℕ),
                            Set.EqOn (NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.vectorMode (ν n) (Φ n) (a n))
                              (NavierStokes.CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl (G.radius n) (G.radial n) (G.angular n)
                                (G.axial n) (B n))
                              s.domain) →
                          (∀ x ∈ s.domain, s.zeta x ≤ 1) →
                            (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ s.domain, 0 ≤ P n x) →
                              (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ s.domain, P n x ≤ 1) →
                                ∃ (c : NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.Family D),
                                  NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.WaveVector s P (α + β - κ) c ∧
                                    ∀ (n : ℕ),
                                      ∀ x ∈ s.domain,
                                        NavierStokes.LinearWaveResidual.transport (G.radius n) (G.radial n)
                                            (G.angular n) (G.axial n)
                                            (NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.vectorMode (ν n) (Φ n) (a n))
                                            (NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.vectorMode (ξ n) (Φ n) (b n)) x =
                                          fun (i : Fin 3) =>
                                          c n x i * NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.carrier (ν n + ξ n) (Φ n) x

∀ {D : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup D] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ D] {U : Set D} {R : D → ℝ} {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D},
  NavierStokes.CurlClassBounds.CylindricalGeometry U R Vr Vθ Vz →
    ∀ {d h : ℝ} {vr vt : NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.Plane}
      (sys : NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.SlotSystem d h vr vt) {L M : NavierStokes.SlotColoring.Label},
      1 ≤ L.1 →
        1 ≤ M.1 →
          L ≠ M →
            ∀ (q : D → ℝ) (X : D → NavierStokes.SlotColoring.Position)
              (Y : D → NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.Plane),
              (∀ y ∈ U, 0 < q y) →
                ∀ (f g : Fin 3 → NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.Plane → ℝ)
                  (a b : D → NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.ComplexVector),
                  (∀ (i : Fin 3),
                      Function.support (f i) ⊆ NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.slotSet h sys.radius vr vt L) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin 3),
                        Function.support (g i) ⊆ NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.slotSet h sys.radius vr vt M) →
                      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.slotField d h L q X Y f a) U →
                        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.slotField d h M q X Y g b) U →
                          ∀ {x : D},
                            x ∈ U →
                              NavierStokes.LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz
                                  (NavierStokes.CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl R Vr Vθ Vz
                                    (NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.slotField d h L q X Y f a))
                                  (NavierStokes.CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl R Vr Vθ Vz
                                    (NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.slotField d h M q X Y g b))
                                  x =
                                0

exact.text:
∀ {D : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup D] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ D] {s : NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.StripData D}
  {P : ℕ → D → ℝ} {α κ : ℝ} {R : D → ℝ} {Vr Vθ Vz : ℕ → D → D} {K : ℕ → ℝ} {Φ : ℕ → D → ℝ}
  {a : ℕ → D → NavierStokes.CurlClassBounds.ComplexVector},
  (NavierStokes.PhaseJetBounds.PolynomialJets (NavierStokes.CurlClassBounds.phaseDomain s) fun (n : ℕ) =>
      NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.phaseNormal R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n) (Φ n)) →
    NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.WaveClass s P α a →
      ∀ {b M : ℝ},
        0 < b →
          (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ s.domain, b ≤ ‖NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.phaseNormal R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n) (Φ n) x‖) →
            (∀ (n : ℕ),
                ∀ x ∈ s.domain, ‖NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.phaseNormal R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n) (Φ n) x‖ ≤ M) →
              0 ≤ κ →
                NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.UnweightedClass s (-κ) Vr →
                  NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.UnweightedClass s 0 Vθ →
                    NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.UnweightedClass s 1 Vz →
                      (NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.UnweightedClass s 0 fun (x : ℕ) (x_1 : D) => (R x_1)⁻¹) →
                        (NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.BandBound s (1 / 2) fun (n : ℕ) => 1 / K n) →
                          NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.WaveClass s P (α + 1 / 2 - κ) fun (n : ℕ) =>
                            NavierStokes.CurlClassBounds.curlRemainder (K n) R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n)
                              (NavierStokes.CurlClassBounds.coefficient R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n) (Φ n) (a n))
